description: Defines classes for capturing runtime statistics of a silo in Orleans, including overall statistics, grain-specific stats, and detailed reports.

classes.name: SiloRuntimeStatistics
classes.description: Encapsulates current runtime statistics for a silo, including activation counts, memory usage, CPU utilization, message counts, and environment metrics.

classes.name: SimpleGrainStatistic
classes.description: Snapshot of current statistics for a specific grain type on a silo, mainly activation count.

classes.name: DetailedGrainStatistic
classes.description: Detailed info about a grain type on a silo, including grain ID.

classes.name: DetailedGrainReport
classes.description: Comprehensive report on grain activations and addresses within a silo, including local cache, directory, and primary placement.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the runtime statistics.
